works.title: See, Point, Fly: A Learning-Free VLM Framework for Universal Unmanned Aerial Navigation

supported_claims: Frozen VLM predicts a 2D waypoint and a 1-10 travel-distance label from RGB and instruction.

small/distant grounding

works.title: AeroVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation via Minimalist End-to-End Control
works.decision_relevance: Selected C7/C8 direct-action representative; defines the current-frame dual-view, fuzzy-hint, numerical-action and intrinsic-LAND mechanism.
supported_claims: Vertically mosaics front/down RGB, combines the image with one of seven coarse relative-bearing phrases and the target description, and autoregressively emits three 0-98 numerical bins for forward/vertical/yaw offsets plus intrinsic LAND.
Official evaluation code, Apache-2.0 LoRA weights and training data are now released; the 15.1 GB OpenVLA-7B base remains separately required.
The paper reports 17 GB VRAM and 0.38 s inference on RTX 4090, so native BF16 does not fit the local 8 GB RTX 4060.
works.task: open-world aerial vision-language navigation with direct kinematic action authority
inputs: coarse relative bearing from onboard localization
works.method: OpenVLA-7B with r64 LoRA and fully trained projector; 99-bin standard numerical tokens; current observation only
works.temporal_spatial_assumptions: reactive current-frame policy; target-relative coarse bearing available; low-level stabilization below the model
works.deployment_setting: TravelUAV/AirSim simulation; physical deployment not demonstrated
works.data: https://huggingface.co/XuPeng23/AerialVLA (257 MB training JSON); TravelUAV environments separately required
works.weights: https://huggingface.co/XuPeng23/AerialVLA (463 MB LoRA) plus https://huggingface.co/openvla/openvla-7b (15.1 GB base)
works.licenses: official AeroVLA repository and LoRA: Apache-2.0; OpenVLA-7B: MIT; arXiv text: arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license
works.compute: training: 4x RTX 4090 24 GB for ~35 h; inference: 17 GB VRAM and 0.38 s on RTX 4090; local machine: RTX 4060 8 GB
limitations: native BF16 exceeds local VRAM
model assumes a target-relative coarse bearing unavailable for unknown-location object search
paper success radius is 20 m whereas this testbed requires 2-2.5 m and explicit terminal stop
simulation-only evaluation
behavior cloning can hover under severe out-of-distribution occlusion
no explicit history or global backtracking
works.reproducibility_notes: Full paper, official code, wrapper, dataset code, action executor, repository license and Hugging Face resource listings inspected 2026-08-25.

works.title: OnFly: Onboard Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-Language Navigation toward Safety and Efficiency
works.decision_relevance: Selected C3-C5 hybrid representative and defining source for image-goal decision, independent monitoring, hybrid memory, verification and planning.
supported_claims: Uses a high-rate image-point Decision Agent with the previous goal reprojected as a history cue and an independent low-rate CONTINUE/STOP/LOST Monitoring Agent.
Builds monitoring context from initial frame, four distance-segment keyframes and latest frame for long-horizon context and prefix stability.
Caps depth at 7 m, applies semantic/depth refinement and a Gaussian bearing range gate, then plans collision-free receding-horizon trajectories.
Reports 67.8% success and 2.7% collision rate; planner removal reduces success to 35.8% and increases collision rate to 37.5%.
works.task: fully onboard zero-shot aerial vision-language navigation across object, precise and long-range tasks
works.method: shared-perception dual agent; hybrid keyframe-recent memory; semantic-geometric verification; Fast Planner
works.temporal_spatial_assumptions: decision and monitor have independent contexts/rates; monitor runs every 2 s; keyframe budget 4; local ESDF available
works.deployment_setting: 10 Unreal/AirSim scenes, 150 tasks, and four fully onboard real UAV tasks on Jetson Orin NX
datasets: 150 private simulation tasks: 40% object, 40% precise, 20% long-range
works.code: https://github.com/Robotics-STAR-Lab/OnFly; README says code coming soon as of 2026-08-25
works.licenses: repository license not published; arXiv text under arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license
works.compute: Jetson Orin NX 16 GB real deployment; RTX 4090 simulation evaluation; paper uses AWQ LLM and FP16 ViT
limitations: official implementation and exact prompts are not released
shared ViT feature and separate KV-cache mechanisms cannot be reproduced through Ollama
paper uses private environments/tasks and a 5 m success radius
exact keyframe trigger and bearing sigma values are not published
works.reproducibility_notes: Full paper methods/results and official repository inspected 2026-08-25; normalized testbed choices are separately locked and never presented as native source code.
